column1: # Probe pet talk (plan v5 and v6): Mission Control and the probe talk on the radio. probe_chat and probe_sleepy:
# MC starts. probe_hail (v6): the probe starts with a beep, MC answers. New keys: pp_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.
# probe rows are subtitle only: empty spanish, english like [beeps excitedly], a beep mood. Core holds for the whole scene.
# Cores: stayputnik eager old-timer, okto clever show-off, hecs anxious perfectionist, rovemate lazy dog, snob posh and aloof, generic plain.

column16: Vale, vale. De una en una.
column17: Okay, okay. One at a time.
Have you learned to turn yet?

column16: Eres la sonda más antigua del programa.
column17: You're the oldest probe in the program.

column16: Pequeño, no hace falta pitar en cada vuelta.
column17: Little one, you don't need to beep every orbit.
Did you calculate that all by yourself?

column16: Okto, aquí alguien dice que eres una simple calculadora.
column17: Okto, someone here says you're just a calculator.

column16: Se lo diré. Con tus palabras.
column17: I'll pass that on. In your words.

column16: ¿Nos ayudas con los deberes de mecánica orbital?
column17: Can you help us with our orbital mechanics homework?

column16: HECS, todo está bien. De verdad.

column17: Did you check the numbers again?

column16: ¿Cuántas veces? No, no me lo digas.
column17: How many times? No, don't tell me.

column16: Tu inclinación está medio grado desviada.
column17: Your inclination is off by half a degree.

column16: Respira, HECS. Bueno, tú no respiras.
column17: Breathe, HECS. Well, you don't breathe.
Why are you beeping in alphabetical order?
Who's a good probe? You are!

column16: Si haces ciencia, te damos una galleta.
column17: If you do some science, you get a cookie.
Want to say hi to the Stayputnik?

column16: Te hemos puesto en un cohete muy caro.
column17: We put you on a very expensive rocket.
Excuse me, could you turn a little?
We don't know what model you are.

column16: Eres una sonda muy... de sonda.
Stayputnik, cuéntanos algo de tus tiempos.
column17: Stayputnik, tell us about the old days.
And you had no reaction wheels?
Rovemate, do you want to go for a ride?
Your excellency, can we get you anything?
We don't have tea in orbit.
Probe, do you hear us well?

column16: Lo sabemos. Nos lo contaste ayer.
column17: We know. You told us yesterday.

column16: ¿Aburrido? Eres una esfera en el espacio.
column17: Bored? You're a ball in space.
Okto, are you correcting our numbers again?

column16: ¿Ya te aburres? Te buscaremos algo más difícil.
column17: Bored already? We'll find you something harder.

column16: Paciencia, Okto. Ya llegará la maniobra.
column17: Patience, Okto. The maneuver will come.

column16: Gracias por la corrección. Otra vez.
HECS, no es nada. Nunca es nada.
column17: HECS, it's nothing. It's always nothing.

column16: Sí, HECS, la lista está al día.
column17: Yes, HECS, the checklist is up to date.

column16: Lo hemos visto. Medio grado. Sobreviviremos.
column17: We saw it. Half a degree. We'll survive.
Is that a rock? Very nice. Leave it.
We'll go for a ride later.

column16: No, su excelencia, todavía no hay mejora.
column17: No, your excellency, no upgrade yet.

column16: Es la misma vista de siempre.
column17: It's the same view as always.

column16: Sí, su excelencia. Un informe. Enseguida.
column17: Yes, your excellency. A report. Right away.

column16: No sabemos la respuesta. Ni la pregunta.
column17: We don't know the answer. Or the question.

column1: # plan v6: callouts, plan_node, stress, say again, milestones, rover, data

column17: Probe, you're spinning too much. Hang on.

column16: Mucha presión de aire. Aguanta un poco.
column17: Lots of air pressure. Hang on a bit.

column16: El suelo está cerca. Muy cerca.
column17: The ground is close. Very close.

column16: Hace calor ahí fuera, lo sabemos.
column17: It's hot out there, we know.

column16: Eso brillante es plasma. Es normal.
column17: That glow is plasma. It's normal.

column16: Queda poco combustible. Lo estamos viendo.
column17: Fuel is low. We're watching it.

column16: Eso fue un golpe fuerte. ¿Sigues ahí?
column17: That was a hard knock. Still there?
We lost an engine. No panic.
We see it, we see it.

column16: HECS, el escudo aguanta. Confía en él.
column17: HECS, the shield holds. Trust it.

column16: Stayputnik, no tienes control de giro. Lo sentimos.
column17: Stayputnik, you have no attitude control. Sorry.

column16: Aguanta, Stayputnik, eres más fuerte de lo que pareces.
column17: Hold on, Stayputnik, you're tougher than you look.

column16: No te oímos bien. Otra vez.
column17: We can't hear you well. Again.

column16: Primer día completo en el espacio. Felicidades.
column17: First full day in space. Congratulations.

column16: Un día entero, Stayputnik. Nadie lo esperaba.
column17: A whole day, Stayputnik. Nobody expected that.

column16: Sí, Rovemate, un día entero. Buen chico.
column17: Yes, Rovemate, a whole day. Good boy.

column16: Diez días de misión. Todo en orden.
column17: Ten days of mission. All in order.

column16: Cien días. Eres toda una veterana.
column17: One hundred days. You're quite the veteran.

column16: HECS, cien días sin un solo problema.
column17: HECS, one hundred days without a single problem.

column16: Sí, su excelencia, cien días. Hay pastel.
column17: Yes, your excellency, one hundred days. There's cake.

column16: Un año entero de misión. Increíble.
column17: A whole year of mission. Incredible.
You're in orbit. What a view.

column16: En órbita, Stayputnik. Como en los viejos tiempos.
column17: In orbit, Stayputnik. Like the old days.
We touched {body} for the first time.
Yes, Rovemate, you may explore. Slowly.

column16: Las ruedas van en el suelo, Rovemate.
column17: Wheels go on the ground, Rovemate.

column1: # Serious phases (launch, ascent, reentry, descent): MC keeps talking to the probe, short and calm. Core any.

column17: Probe, clean telemetry. Keep it up.

column16: Vemos todos tus datos. Buen trabajo.
column17: We see all your data. Good work.

column16: Vas muy rápido. Eso es bueno.
column17: You're going very fast. That's good.

column16: Respira hondo. Bueno, tú no respiras.
column17: Take a deep breath. Well, you don't breathe.
Control to probe. Do you read?

column16: Todo el equipo te está mirando.
column17: The whole team is watching you.
Probe, this is Control. We're tracking you.

column16: Ya queda menos para la órbita.
Sonda, aguanta el calor un poco más.
column17: Probe, hold through the heat a little longer.

column16: Sonda, el suelo se acerca. Con calma.
column17: Probe, the ground is getting closer. Easy.
